name: Rick Hallam
text:
My Wife and I moved to Calgary in 2018, we bought a home in Sundance knowing it was an older home and would need some love. We’ve now spent 8 years pouring love into our home, and Bobby has been along with us almost from the start.

Bobby is without question an extremely gifted electrician, and as someone who has spent 30 years managing large maintenance and engineering teams, I have a deep appreciation for the attention to safety that Bobby has.

I could tell you about the great work he did in our entrance, I could tell you about great work he did in our new kitchen, but it’s the work that he did in our attic that I will always appreciate the most.

Squirrels, damn Squirrels. They got in our attic and ate near to all of the insulation off of the wiring. Further, they had chewed away at a few wood members. Bobby did an amazing job, and went well beyond expectations.

With so much work in my home done by Bobby, and so many good chats, I call Bobby a friend, and would never hesitate to call on him for any electrical work needed in my home.

You should too!

Rick
